<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_figure">Figure 6: </span>PCC@M and MSE curves for EGN baseline and EGN+ECA on 10xProteomic dataset under each fold. Curves for PCC@S and PCC@F please refer to <a href="#A6.F8" title="In Extra Results. ‣ G.3 Spatial Transcriptomic Dataset ‣ Appendix G Detailed Experimental Settings ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Figure</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">8</span></a> and <a href="#A7.F9" title="In Extra Results. ‣ G.3 Spatial Transcriptomic Dataset ‣ Appendix G Detailed Experimental Settings ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Figure</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">9</span></a>.</figcaption>
</figure>
<div id="S5.SS2.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S5.SS2.p4.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S5.SS2.p4.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) Dataset.</span> Since ALMT optimizes MSE loss only, we test two settings: (i) ALMT with an additional PCC loss; and (ii) ALMT with ECA adapted into the video attention encoder and trained with the dispersion-normalized PCC loss. <a href="#S5.T2" title="In 5.2 Results and analysis ‣ 5 Experiments ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Table</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2</span></a> reports results of 10 baselines. Adding a PCC term yields a small PCC gain but degrades F1 and MAE, reflecting the MSE-PCC conflict under strong in-sample homogeneity. In contrast, adding ECA improves all metrics, achieving a <math id="S5.SS2.p4.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="+2.3\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mn>2.3</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">+2.3\%</annotation></semantics></math> PCC increase without sacrificing F1 or MAE.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="S6" class="ltx_section">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_section"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_section">6 </span>Conclusion</h2>

<div id="S6.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S6.p1.1" class="ltx_p">This work presents the first theoretical investigation into the PCC plateau phenomenon observed when training attention-based regression models with a joint MSE+PCC loss, particularly under high data homogeneity. Our analysis identified two fundamental limitations in standard softmax attention: conflict in optimization dynamics that attenuate the correlation gradient, and an achievable PCC bound imposed by convex aggregation. To address these bottlenecks, we introduced ECA, a novel plug-in framework incorporating mechanisms to stabilize optimization, adapt to homogeneity, and extrapolate beyond the convex hull. Comprehensive experiments validate our theoretical insights and demonstrate that ECA successfully breaks the PCC plateau, achieving significant correlation gains while maintaining competitive magnitude performance.</p>
</div>
<div class="ltx_pagination ltx_role_newpage"></div>
</section>

See <a href="#A1" title="Appendix A Preliminaries ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Appendix</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">A</span></a> for results from <a href="#S2.SS2" title="2.2 Preliminaries: The Interplay Between MSE and PCC ‣ 2 Theoretical Analysis of Correlation Learning in Attention-based Aggregation ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Section</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.2</span></a>, <a href="#A2" title="Appendix B Gradient Analysis of Correlation ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Appendix</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">B</span></a> for <a href="#S2.SS3" title="2.3 Optimization Dynamics: The Correlation Gradient Bottleneck ‣ 2 Theoretical Analysis of Correlation Learning in Attention-based Aggregation ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Section</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.3</span></a>, and <a href="#A4" title="Appendix D Achievable PCC Bound of Convex Attention Models ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Appendix</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">D</span></a> for <a href="#S3" title="3 Extrapolative Correlation Attention (ECA) ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Section</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">3</span></a>.</p>

<p id="S7.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Processing details for all datasets (synthetic and real-world) are listed in <a href="#A7" title="Appendix G Detailed Experimental Settings ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Appendix</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">G</span></a>.</p>

<section id="S7.SS0.SSS0.Px3" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Code Reproducibility</h5>

<div id="S7.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S7.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We include an anonymous zip file with implementations for the synthetic and spatial transcriptomics datasets along with the hyperparameters we use for review. For the spatial transcriptomic dataset, we follow the EGN baseline preprocessing protocol. Due to the limited space, we did not include the dataset. The README.md explains how to get the data and run the code. The complete code can be found in <a href="https://github.com/jyan97/ECA-Extrapolative-Correlation-Attention" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_url ltx_font_typewriter">https://github.com/jyan97/ECA-Extrapolative-Correlation-Attention</a>.</p>

<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix A </span>Preliminaries</h2>

<section id="A1.SS1" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">A.1 </span>Proof for <a href="#S2.Thmproposition1" title="Proposition 2.1 (MSE Mean–std–correlation Decomposition). ‣ 2.2 Preliminaries: The Interplay Between MSE and PCC ‣ 2 Theoretical Analysis of Correlation Learning in Attention-based Aggregation ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Proposition</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.1</span></a></h3>

<div id="A1.Thmproposition1" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_proposition">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="A1.Thmproposition1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Proposition A.1</span></span><span id="A1.Thmproposition1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold"> </span>(MSE Mean–std–correlation Decomposition)<span id="A1.Thmproposition1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">.</span></h6>
<div id="A1.Thmproposition1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A1.Thmproposition1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.Thmproposition1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Let <math id="A1.Thmproposition1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="y,\hat{y}\in\mathbb{R}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>,</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mi>ℝ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y,\hat{y}\in\mathbb{R}</annotation></semantics></math> be the ground truth and predictions across <math id="A1.Thmproposition1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="S" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>S</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">S</annotation></semantics></math> samples. Let <math id="A1.Thmproposition1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mu_{y},\mu_{\hat{y}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>μ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mu_{y},\mu_{\hat{y}}</annotation></semantics></math> be the empirical means, and <math id="A1.Thmproposition1.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sigma_{y},\sigma_{\hat{y}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sigma_{y},\sigma_{\hat{y}}</annotation></semantics></math> be the empirical standard deviations. The Mean Squared Error can be decomposed as:</span></p>
<table id="A1.EGx5" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A1.E13"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A1.E13.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\operatorname{MSE}(y,\hat{y})=(\mu_{\hat{y}}-\mu_{y})^{2}+(\sigma_{\hat{y}}-\sigma_{y})^{2}+2\,\sigma_{y}\,\sigma_{\hat{y}}\,\bigl(1-\rho\bigr)." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>MSE</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>,</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>μ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>ρ</mi></mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\operatorname{MSE}(y,\hat{y})=(\mu_{\hat{y}}-\mu_{y})^{2}+(\sigma_{\hat{y}}-\sigma_{y})^{2}+2\,\sigma_{y}\,\sigma_{\hat{y}}\,\bigl(1-\rho\bigr).</annotation></semantics></math></td>

<p id="A1.SS1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text">Write the error for sample <math id="A1.SS1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="i" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>i</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">i</annotation></semantics></math> as</span></p>

<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A1.E16.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\Bigl(\,(y_{i}-\mu_{y})-(\hat{y}_{i}-\mu_{\hat{y}})\,\Bigr)^{2}+(\mu_{y}-\mu_{\hat{y}})^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>N</mi></mfrac></mstyle><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><munderover><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>N</mi></munderover></mstyle><msup><mrow><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em" rspace="0.170em">(</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>y</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mrow><mo rspace="0.170em" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mrow><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>μ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\Bigl(\,(y_{i}-\mu_{y})-(\hat{y}_{i}-\mu_{\hat{y}})\,\Bigr)^{2}+(\mu_{y}-\mu_{\hat{y}})^{2}</annotation></semantics></math></td>

<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A1.E17.m1" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="\displaystyle+\;\frac{2(\mu_{y}-\mu_{\hat{y}})}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\Bigl((y_{i}-\mu_{y})-(\hat{y}_{i}-\mu_{\hat{y}})\Bigr)." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo rspace="0.502em">+</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>μ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mi>N</mi></mfrac></mstyle><mstyle displaystyle="true"><munderover><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>N</mi></munderover></mstyle><mrow><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em">(</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>y</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle+\;\frac{2(\mu_{y}-\mu_{\hat{y}})}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\Bigl((y_{i}-\mu_{y})-(\hat{y}_{i}-\mu_{\hat{y}})\Bigr).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(17)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A1.SS1.p2.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS1.p2.2.1" class="ltx_text">The last sum vanishes since <math id="A1.SS1.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sum_{i}(y_{i}-\mu_{y})=\sum_{i}(\hat{y}_{i}-\mu_{\hat{y}})=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mo>∑</mo><mi>i</mi></msub><mrow><mo lspace="0em" stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>y</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="0.111em">=</mo><mrow><msub><mo rspace="0em">∑</mo><mi>i</mi></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sum_{i}(y_{i}-\mu_{y})=\sum_{i}(\hat{y}_{i}-\mu_{\hat{y}})=0</annotation></semantics></math>. Expanding the remaining square and using the definitions of variances, <math id="A1.SS1.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\operatorname{Cov}(y,\hat{y})=\sigma_{y}\sigma_{\hat{y}}\rho" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>Cov</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>,</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>ρ</mi></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{Cov}(y,\hat{y})=\sigma_{y}\sigma_{\hat{y}}\rho</annotation></semantics></math>, we obtain</span></p>
<table id="A1.EGx8" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A1.E18"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A1.E18.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\operatorname{MSE}(y,\hat{y})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>MSE</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>,</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\operatorname{MSE}(y,\hat{y})</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A1.E18.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=(\mu_{\hat{y}}-\mu_{y})^{2}+\sigma_{y}^{2}+\sigma_{\hat{y}}^{2}-\frac{2}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}(y_{i}-\mu_{y})(\hat{y}_{i}-\mu_{\hat{y}})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>μ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msubsup><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup><mo>+</mo><msubsup><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mn>2</mn><mi>N</mi></mfrac></mstyle><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><munderover><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>N</mi></munderover></mstyle><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>y</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=(\mu_{\hat{y}}-\mu_{y})^{2}+\sigma_{y}^{2}+\sigma_{\hat{y}}^{2}-\frac{2}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}(y_{i}-\mu_{y})(\hat{y}_{i}-\mu_{\hat{y}})</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(18)</span></td></tr></tbody>
<tbody id="A1.E19"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_eqn_cell"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A1.E19.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=(\mu_{\hat{y}}-\mu_{y})^{2}+\sigma_{y}^{2}+\sigma_{\hat{y}}^{2}-2\sigma_{y}\sigma_{\hat{y}}\rho." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>μ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msubsup><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup><mo>+</mo><msubsup><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>ρ</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=(\mu_{\hat{y}}-\mu_{y})^{2}+\sigma_{y}^{2}+\sigma_{\hat{y}}^{2}-2\sigma_{y}\sigma_{\hat{y}}\rho.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(19)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div id="A1.SS1.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A1.SS1.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS1.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text">Finally, rearranging <math id="A1.SS1.p3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sigma_{y}^{2}+\sigma_{\hat{y}}^{2}-2\,\sigma_{y}\,\sigma_{\hat{y}}\,\rho=(\sigma_{\hat{y}}-\sigma_{y})^{2}+2\,\sigma_{y}\,\sigma_{\hat{y}}\,(1-\rho)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msubsup><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup><mo>+</mo><msubsup><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>ρ</mi></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>ρ</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sigma_{y}^{2}+\sigma_{\hat{y}}^{2}-2\,\sigma_{y}\,\sigma_{\hat{y}}\,\rho=(\sigma_{\hat{y}}-\sigma_{y})^{2}+2\,\sigma_{y}\,\sigma_{\hat{y}}\,(1-\rho)</annotation></semantics></math> yields the claimed decomposition.
∎</span></p>

<section id="A1.SS2" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">A.2 </span>Proof for <a href="#S2.Thmlemma1" title="Lemma 2.1 (Scaling-invariance of PCC). ‣ 2.2 Preliminaries: The Interplay Between MSE and PCC ‣ 2 Theoretical Analysis of Correlation Learning in Attention-based Aggregation ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Lemma</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.1</span></a></h3>

<div id="A1.Thmlemma1" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_lemma">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="A1.Thmlemma1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Lemma A.1</span></span><span id="A1.Thmlemma1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold"> </span>(Scaling Invariance of PCC)<span id="A1.Thmlemma1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">.</span></h6>
<div id="A1.Thmlemma1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A1.Thmlemma1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.Thmlemma1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Let <math id="A1.Thmlemma1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="m\in\mathbb{R}\setminus\{0\}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>m</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mi>ℝ</mi><mo>∖</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">m\in\mathbb{R}\setminus\{0\}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A1.Thmlemma1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n\in\mathbb{R}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>ℝ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n\in\mathbb{R}</annotation></semantics></math>. For any sample <math id="A1.Thmlemma1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\{(y_{i},\hat{y}_{i})\}_{i=1}^{S}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>y</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>i</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>S</mi></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\{(y_{i},\hat{y}_{i})\}_{i=1}^{S}</annotation></semantics></math>,</span></p>
<table id="A1.EGx9" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<div id="A1.Thmlemma1.5" class="ltx_proof">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_font_italic ltx_title_proof">Proof.</h6>
<div id="A1.Thmlemma1.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A1.Thmlemma1.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.Thmlemma1.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text">Using <math id="A1.Thmlemma1.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\rho(u,v)=\frac{\operatorname{Cov}(u,v)}{\sigma_{u}\sigma_{v}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>ρ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>u</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>Cov</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>u</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>u</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>v</mi></msub></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\rho(u,v)=\frac{\operatorname{Cov}(u,v)}{\sigma_{u}\sigma_{v}}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A1.Thmlemma1.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sigma_{m\hat{y}+n}=|m|\,\sigma_{\hat{y}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><mrow><mrow><mi>m</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow><mo>+</mo><mi>n</mi></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi>m</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sigma_{m\hat{y}+n}=|m|\,\sigma_{\hat{y}}</annotation></semantics></math>,</span></p>
<table id="A1.EGx10" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A1.E21"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A1.E21.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\operatorname{PCC}\bigl(y,m\hat{y}+n\bigr)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>PCC</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>m</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow><mo>+</mo><mi>n</mi></mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\operatorname{PCC}\bigl(y,m\hat{y}+n\bigr)</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A1.E21.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\frac{\operatorname{Cov}(y,m\hat{y}+n)}{\sigma_{y}\,\sigma_{m\hat{y}+n}}=\frac{m\,\operatorname{Cov}(y,\hat{y})}{\sigma_{y}\,|m|\,\sigma_{\hat{y}}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mi>Cov</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>m</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow><mo>+</mo><mi>n</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mrow><mrow><mi>m</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow><mo>+</mo><mi>n</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle><mo>=</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mi>m</mi><mo lspace="0.337em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mi>Cov</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>,</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi>m</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\frac{\operatorname{Cov}(y,m\hat{y}+n)}{\sigma_{y}\,\sigma_{m\hat{y}+n}}=\frac{m\,\operatorname{Cov}(y,\hat{y})}{\sigma_{y}\,|m|\,\sigma_{\hat{y}}}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(21)</span></td></tr></tbody>

<td class="ltx_td ltx_eqn_cell"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A1.E22.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\frac{m}{|m|}\,\operatorname{PCC}(y,\hat{y})=\operatorname{sign}(m)\operatorname{PCC}(y,\hat{y})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mi>m</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi>m</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow></mfrac></mstyle><mo lspace="0.337em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mi>PCC</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>,</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>sign</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>m</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mi>PCC</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>,</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\frac{m}{|m|}\,\operatorname{PCC}(y,\hat{y})=\operatorname{sign}(m)\operatorname{PCC}(y,\hat{y})</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>

<section id="A2" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix B </span>Gradient Analysis of Correlation</h2>

<section id="A2.SS1" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">B.1 </span>Gradient of Pearson Correlation w.r.t. Attention Logits</h3>

<div id="A2.Thmlemma1" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_lemma">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="A2.Thmlemma1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Lemma B.1</span></span><span id="A2.Thmlemma1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold"> </span>(Softmax Aggregator Jacobian)<span id="A2.Thmlemma1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">.</span></h6>
<div id="A2.Thmlemma1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.Thmlemma1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.Thmlemma1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">The derivative of the aggregated embedding <math id="A2.Thmlemma1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{v}_{s}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{v}_{s}</annotation></semantics></math> with respect to a pre-softmax logit <math id="A2.Thmlemma1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="z_{si}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">z_{si}</annotation></semantics></math> is
<math id="A2.Thmlemma1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\partial\mathbf{v}_{s}/\partial z_{si}=\alpha_{si}(\mathbf{h}_{si}-\mathbf{v}_{s})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>∂</mo><mphantom></mphantom><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo rspace="0.055em">/</mo><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\partial\mathbf{v}_{s}/\partial z_{si}=\alpha_{si}(\mathbf{h}_{si}-\mathbf{v}_{s})</annotation></semantics></math> and consequently, <math id="A2.Thmlemma1.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\partial\hat{y}_{s}/\partial z_{si}=\alpha_{si}\mathbf{w}^{\top}(\mathbf{h}_{si}-\mathbf{v}_{s})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>∂</mo><mphantom></mphantom><mrow><mrow><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>s</mi></msub><mo rspace="0.055em">/</mo><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi>𝐰</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\partial\hat{y}_{s}/\partial z_{si}=\alpha_{si}\mathbf{w}^{\top}(\mathbf{h}_{si}-\mathbf{v}_{s})</annotation></semantics></math>.</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<div id="A2.SS1.2" class="ltx_proof">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_font_italic ltx_title_proof">Proof.</h6>
<div id="A2.SS1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.SS1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text">Within a fixed sample <math id="A2.SS1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>s</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s</annotation></semantics></math>, the aggregated embedding is <math id="A2.SS1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{v}_{s}=\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\alpha_{sj}\mathbf{h}_{sj}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo rspace="0.111em">=</mo><mrow><msubsup><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></msubsup><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{v}_{s}=\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\alpha_{sj}\mathbf{h}_{sj}</annotation></semantics></math>. We first recall the derivative of the softmax function. The partial derivative of the <math id="A2.SS1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="j" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>j</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">j</annotation></semantics></math>-th attention weight <math id="A2.SS1.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha_{sj}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha_{sj}</annotation></semantics></math> with respect to the <math id="A2.SS1.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="i" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>i</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">i</annotation></semantics></math>-th input logit <math id="A2.SS1.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="z_{si}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">z_{si}</annotation></semantics></math> is given by:</span></p>
<table id="A2.EGx11" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A2.E23"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.E23.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\frac{\partial\alpha_{sj}}{\partial z_{si}}=\alpha_{sj}(\delta_{ij}-\alpha_{si})," display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub></mrow><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>δ</mi><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\frac{\partial\alpha_{sj}}{\partial z_{si}}=\alpha_{sj}(\delta_{ij}-\alpha_{si}),</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(23)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.p1.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p1.2.1" class="ltx_text">where <math id="A2.SS1.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\delta_{ij}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>δ</mi><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\delta_{ij}</annotation></semantics></math> is the Kronecker delta (<math id="A2.SS1.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\delta_{ij}=1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>δ</mi><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\delta_{ij}=1</annotation></semantics></math> if <math id="A2.SS1.p1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="i=j" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">i=j</annotation></semantics></math>, and <math id="A2.SS1.p1.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0</annotation></semantics></math> otherwise).</span></p>
</div>
<div id="A2.SS1.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.SS1.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text">We can now compute the derivative of <math id="A2.SS1.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{v}_{s}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{v}_{s}</annotation></semantics></math> with respect to <math id="A2.SS1.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="z_{si}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">z_{si}</annotation></semantics></math> using the chain rule:</span></p>

<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>

<p id="A2.SS1.p2.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p2.2.1" class="ltx_text">The first term simplifies because <math id="A2.SS1.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\delta_{ij}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>δ</mi><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\delta_{ij}</annotation></semantics></math> is non-zero only when <math id="A2.SS1.p2.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="j=i" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">j=i</annotation></semantics></math>:</span></p>
<table id="A2.EGx13" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A2.E27"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">

</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.p2.3" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p2.3.1" class="ltx_text">In the second term, <math id="A2.SS1.p2.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha_{si}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha_{si}</annotation></semantics></math> is independent of the summation index <math id="A2.SS1.p2.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="j" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>j</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">j</annotation></semantics></math> and can be factored out:</span></p>
<table id="A2.EGx14" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A2.E28"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.E28.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\alpha_{sj}\alpha_{si}\mathbf{h}_{sj}=\alpha_{si}\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\alpha_{sj}\mathbf{h}_{sj}=\alpha_{si}\mathbf{v}_{s}." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><munderover><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></munderover></mstyle><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><munderover><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></munderover></mstyle><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\alpha_{sj}\alpha_{si}\mathbf{h}_{sj}=\alpha_{si}\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\alpha_{sj}\mathbf{h}_{sj}=\alpha_{si}\mathbf{v}_{s}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(28)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.p2.4" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p2.4.1" class="ltx_text">Combining these results, we obtain:</span></p>
<table id="A2.EGx15" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A2.E29"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.E29.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\frac{\partial\mathbf{v}_{s}}{\partial z_{si}}=\alpha_{si}\mathbf{h}_{si}-\alpha_{si}\mathbf{v}_{s}=\alpha_{si}(\mathbf{h}_{si}-\mathbf{v}_{s})." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\frac{\partial\mathbf{v}_{s}}{\partial z_{si}}=\alpha_{si}\mathbf{h}_{si}-\alpha_{si}\mathbf{v}_{s}=\alpha_{si}(\mathbf{h}_{si}-\mathbf{v}_{s}).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(29)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.p2.5" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p2.5.1" class="ltx_text">Consequently, since the prediction is <math id="A2.SS1.p2.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\hat{y}_{s}=\mathbf{w}^{\top}\mathbf{v}_{s}+c" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><msup><mi>𝐰</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\hat{y}_{s}=\mathbf{w}^{\top}\mathbf{v}_{s}+c</annotation></semantics></math>, its derivative is:</span></p>
<table id="A2.E30" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.E30.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\frac{\partial\hat{y}_{s}}{\partial z_{si}}=\mathbf{w}^{\top}\frac{\partial\mathbf{v}_{s}}{\partial z_{si}}=\alpha_{si}\,\mathbf{w}^{\top}(\mathbf{h}_{si}-\mathbf{v}_{s})." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mrow><msup><mi>𝐰</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi>𝐰</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\partial\hat{y}_{s}}{\partial z_{si}}=\mathbf{w}^{\top}\frac{\partial\mathbf{v}_{s}}{\partial z_{si}}=\alpha_{si}\,\mathbf{w}^{\top}(\mathbf{h}_{si}-\mathbf{v}_{s}).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(30)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.p2.6" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p2.6.1" class="ltx_text">∎</span></p>

<div id="A2.Thmtheorem1" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_theorem">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="A2.Thmtheorem1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Theorem B.1</span></span><span id="A2.Thmtheorem1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold"> </span>(Gradient of PCC w.r.t. Attention Logits)<span id="A2.Thmtheorem1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">.</span></h6>
<div id="A2.Thmtheorem1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.Thmtheorem1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.Thmtheorem1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">For any <math id="A2.Thmtheorem1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>s</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s</annotation></semantics></math>, the derivative of Pearson correlation <math id="A2.Thmtheorem1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\rho" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>ρ</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\rho</annotation></semantics></math> with respect to a pre-softmax logit <math id="A2.Thmtheorem1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="z_{si}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">z_{si}</annotation></semantics></math> is</span></p>
</div>
<div id="A2.Thmtheorem1.p2" class="ltx_para">
<table id="A2.E31" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.E31.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\frac{\partial\rho}{\partial z_{si}}=\frac{1}{S\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\left(\frac{a_{s}}{\sigma_{y}}-\rho\frac{b_{s}}{\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\right)\alpha_{si}\mathbf{w}^{\top}(\mathbf{h}_{si}-\mathbf{v}_{s})." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mo>∂</mo><mi>ρ</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mrow></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mfrac><msub><mi>a</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub></mfrac><mo>−</mo><mrow><mi>ρ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mfrac><msub><mi>b</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mfrac></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi>𝐰</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\partial\rho}{\partial z_{si}}=\frac{1}{S\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\left(\frac{a_{s}}{\sigma_{y}}-\rho\frac{b_{s}}{\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\right)\alpha_{si}\mathbf{w}^{\top}(\mathbf{h}_{si}-\mathbf{v}_{s}).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(31)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div id="A2.SS1.3" class="ltx_proof">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_font_italic ltx_title_proof">Proof.</h6>
<div id="A2.SS1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.SS1.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text">We express the Pearson correlation <math id="A2.SS1.p3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\rho" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>ρ</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\rho</annotation></semantics></math> as the ratio <math id="A2.SS1.p3.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\rho=N/D" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>ρ</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>N</mi><mo>/</mo><mi>D</mi></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\rho=N/D</annotation></semantics></math>, where <math id="A2.SS1.p3.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="N" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>N</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">N</annotation></semantics></math> is the covariance and <math id="A2.SS1.p3.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="D" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>D</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">D</annotation></semantics></math> is the product of standard deviations.</span></p>
<table id="A2.EGx16" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A2.E32"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.E32.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle N" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>N</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle N</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.E32.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle:=\operatorname{Cov}(y,\hat{y})=\frac{1}{S}\sum_{t=1}^{S}a_{t}b_{t},\quad D:=\sigma_{y}\sigma_{\hat{y}}." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo lspace="0.278em" rspace="0.278em">:</mo><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>Cov</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>,</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>S</mi></mfrac></mstyle><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><munderover><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>S</mi></munderover></mstyle><mrow><msub><mi>a</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>b</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="1.167em">,</mo><mrow><mi>D</mi><mo>:=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle:=\operatorname{Cov}(y,\hat{y})=\frac{1}{S}\sum_{t=1}^{S}a_{t}b_{t},\quad D:=\sigma_{y}\sigma_{\hat{y}}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(32)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.p3.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p3.2.1" class="ltx_text">Recall that <math id="A2.SS1.p3.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="a_{t}:=y_{t}-\mu_{y}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>a</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>:=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>y</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">a_{t}:=y_{t}-\mu_{y}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A2.SS1.p3.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="b_{t}:=\hat{y}_{t}-\mu_{\hat{y}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>b</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>:=</mo><mrow><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">b_{t}:=\hat{y}_{t}-\mu_{\hat{y}}</annotation></semantics></math> are the centered targets and predictions, respectively, satisfying <math id="A2.SS1.p3.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sum_{t}a_{t}=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mo>∑</mo><mi>t</mi></msub><msub><mi>a</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sum_{t}a_{t}=0</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A2.SS1.p3.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sum_{t}b_{t}=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mo>∑</mo><mi>t</mi></msub><msub><mi>b</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sum_{t}b_{t}=0</annotation></semantics></math>.</span></p>
</div>
<div id="A2.SS1.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.SS1.p4.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p4.1.1" class="ltx_text">By the quotient rule, the derivative of <math id="A2.SS1.p4.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\rho" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>ρ</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\rho</annotation></semantics></math> is:</span></p>
<table id="A2.EGx17" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A2.E33"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.E33.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\frac{\partial\rho}{\partial z_{si}}=\frac{1}{D}\frac{\partial N}{\partial z_{si}}-\frac{N}{D^{2}}\frac{\partial D}{\partial z_{si}}=\frac{1}{D}\left(\frac{\partial N}{\partial z_{si}}-\rho\frac{\partial D}{\partial z_{si}}\right)." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mo>∂</mo><mi>ρ</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>D</mi></mfrac></mstyle><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mo>∂</mo><mi>N</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mi>N</mi><msup><mi>D</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mfrac></mstyle><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mo>∂</mo><mi>D</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>D</mi></mfrac></mstyle><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mo>∂</mo><mi>N</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle><mo>−</mo><mrow><mi>ρ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mo>∂</mo><mi>D</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\frac{\partial\rho}{\partial z_{si}}=\frac{1}{D}\frac{\partial N}{\partial z_{si}}-\frac{N}{D^{2}}\frac{\partial D}{\partial z_{si}}=\frac{1}{D}\left(\frac{\partial N}{\partial z_{si}}-\rho\frac{\partial D}{\partial z_{si}}\right).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(33)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div id="A2.SS1.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.SS1.p5.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS1.p5.1.1" class="ltx_text">We compute the derivatives of <math id="A2.SS1.p5.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="N" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>N</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">N</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A2.SS1.p5.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="D" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>D</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">D</annotation></semantics></math> separately. Note that the logit <math id="A2.SS1.p5.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="z_{si}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">z_{si}</annotation></semantics></math> only directly affects the prediction of sample <math id="A2.SS1.p5.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>s</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s</annotation></semantics></math>, i.e., <math id="A2.SS1.p5.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\partial\hat{y}_{t}/\partial z_{si}=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>∂</mo><mphantom></mphantom><mrow><mrow><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>t</mi></msub><mo rspace="0.055em">/</mo><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\partial\hat{y}_{t}/\partial z_{si}=0</annotation></semantics></math> if <math id="A2.SS1.p5.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t\neq s" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>≠</mo><mi>s</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t\neq s</annotation></semantics></math>.</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<section id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px1" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Step 1: Derivative of the Covariance (<math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="N" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>N</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">N</annotation></semantics></math>).</h5>

<div id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<table id="A2.EGx18" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A2.E34"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>

<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1.3" class="ltx_p">Since the targets are centered (<math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sum_{t}a_{t}=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mo>∑</mo><mi>t</mi></msub><msub><mi>a</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sum_{t}a_{t}=0</annotation></semantics></math>), the second term vanishes:</p>

<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1.4" class="ltx_p">Since <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\partial\hat{y}_{t}/\partial z_{si}=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>∂</mo><mphantom></mphantom><mrow><mrow><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>t</mi></msub><mo rspace="0.055em">/</mo><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\partial\hat{y}_{t}/\partial z_{si}=0</annotation></semantics></math> for <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t\neq s" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>≠</mo><mi>s</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t\neq s</annotation></semantics></math>, the summation collapses to a single term:</p>

<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.E39.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\frac{\partial N}{\partial z_{si}}=\frac{1}{S}a_{s}\,\frac{\partial\hat{y}_{s}}{\partial z_{si}}." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mo>∂</mo><mi>N</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle><mo>=</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>S</mi></mfrac></mstyle><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>a</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\frac{\partial N}{\partial z_{si}}=\frac{1}{S}a_{s}\,\frac{\partial\hat{y}_{s}}{\partial z_{si}}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>

</section>
<section id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Step 2: Derivative of the Standard Deviation Product (<math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="D" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>D</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">D</annotation></semantics></math>).</h5>

<div id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Since <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sigma_{y}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sigma_{y}</annotation></semantics></math> is constant with respect to <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="z_{si}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">z_{si}</annotation></semantics></math>, we have <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\partial D/\partial z_{si}=\sigma_{y}(\partial\sigma_{\hat{y}}/\partial z_{si})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>∂</mo><mphantom></mphantom><mrow><mrow><mi>D</mi><mo rspace="0.055em">/</mo><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mo lspace="0em">∂</mo><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub><mo rspace="0.055em">/</mo><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\partial D/\partial z_{si}=\sigma_{y}(\partial\sigma_{\hat{y}}/\partial z_{si})</annotation></semantics></math>. To find the derivative of <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sigma_{\hat{y}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sigma_{\hat{y}}</annotation></semantics></math>, we first differentiate the variance <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sigma_{\hat{y}}^{2}=\frac{1}{S}\sum_{t}b_{t}^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mn>2</mn></msubsup><mo>=</mo><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>S</mi></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><msub><mo>∑</mo><mi>t</mi></msub><msubsup><mi>b</mi><mi>t</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sigma_{\hat{y}}^{2}=\frac{1}{S}\sum_{t}b_{t}^{2}</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
<table id="A2.EGx23" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A2.E40"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.E40.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\frac{\partial\sigma_{\hat{y}}^{2}}{\partial z_{si}}=\frac{\partial}{\partial z_{si}}\left(\frac{1}{S}\sum_{t}b_{t}^{2}\right)=\frac{1}{S}\sum_{t}2b_{t}\frac{\partial b_{t}}{\partial z_{si}}." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msubsup><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle><mo>=</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mo>∂</mo><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mi>t</mi></munder></mstyle><msubsup><mi>b</mi><mi>t</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mstyle movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mi>t</mi></munder></mstyle><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>b</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mstyle rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\frac{\partial\sigma_{\hat{y}}^{2}}{\partial z_{si}}=\frac{\partial}{\partial z_{si}}\left(\frac{1}{S}\sum_{t}b_{t}^{2}\right)=\frac{1}{S}\sum_{t}2b_{t}\frac{\partial b_{t}}{\partial z_{si}}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(40)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.2" class="ltx_p">Similar to Step 1, we substitute the expression for <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\partial b_{t}/\partial z_{si}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>∂</mo><mrow><msub><mi>b</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo rspace="0.055em">/</mo><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\partial b_{t}/\partial z_{si}</annotation></semantics></math> and use the fact that the predictions are centered (<math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sum_{t}b_{t}=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mo>∑</mo><mi>t</mi></msub><msub><mi>b</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sum_{t}b_{t}=0</annotation></semantics></math>):</p>

<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.3" class="ltx_p">Again, since <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\partial\hat{y}_{t}/\partial z_{si}=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>∂</mo><mphantom></mphantom><mrow><mrow><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>t</mi></msub><mo rspace="0.055em">/</mo><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\partial\hat{y}_{t}/\partial z_{si}=0</annotation></semantics></math> for <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t\neq s" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>≠</mo><mi>s</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t\neq s</annotation></semantics></math>:</p>
<table id="A2.EGx25" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.4" class="ltx_p">We now use the chain rule: <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\frac{\partial\sigma_{\hat{y}}^{2}}{\partial z_{si}}=2\sigma_{\hat{y}}\frac{\partial\sigma_{\hat{y}}}{\partial z_{si}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msubsup><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mrow><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\partial\sigma_{\hat{y}}^{2}}{\partial z_{si}}=2\sigma_{\hat{y}}\frac{\partial\sigma_{\hat{y}}}{\partial z_{si}}</annotation></semantics></math>. Equating the two expressions and solving for <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\frac{\partial\sigma_{\hat{y}}}{\partial z_{si}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mfrac><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mrow><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\partial\sigma_{\hat{y}}}{\partial z_{si}}</annotation></semantics></math> (assuming <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sigma_{\hat{y}}&gt;0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sigma_{\hat{y}}&gt;0</annotation></semantics></math>):</p>

z_{si}}=\frac{b_{s}}{S\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\frac{\partial\hat{y}_{s}}{\partial z_{si}}." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mn>2</mn><mi>S</mi></mfrac></mstyle><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>b</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mover rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle></mrow></mrow><mspace style="width:1em;" width="1em"></mspace><mo stretchy="false">⟹</mo><mspace style="width:1em;" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle><mo>=</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><msub><mi>b</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" 2\sigma_{\hat{y}}\frac{\partial\sigma_{\hat{y}}}{\partial z_{si}}=\frac{2}{S}\,b_{s}\,\frac{\partial\hat{y}_{s}}{\partial z_{si}}\quad\implies\quad\frac{\partial\sigma_{\hat{y}}}{\partial <p id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.5" class="ltx_p">Therefore, the derivative of the denominator <math id="A2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m13" class="ltx_Math" alttext="D" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>D</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">D</annotation></semantics></math> is:</p>
<table id="A2.EGx27" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A2.E46"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>

<section id="A3" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix C </span>Proofs for Optimization Dynamics Analysis</h2>

<section id="A3.SS1" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">C.1 </span>Proof of Lemma <a href="#S2.Thmlemma3" title="Lemma 2.3 (Gradient of MSE w.r.t. Attention Logits). ‣ 2.3 Optimization Dynamics: The Correlation Gradient Bottleneck ‣ 2 Theoretical Analysis of Correlation Learning in Attention-based Aggregation ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.3</span></a> (Gradient of MSE w.r.t. Attention Logits)</h3>

<div id="A3.SS1.2" class="ltx_proof">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_font_italic ltx_title_proof">Proof.</h6>
<div id="A3.SS1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text">The Mean Squared Error (MSE) loss is defined as:</span></p>
<table id="A3.E52" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A3.E52.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{MSE}}=\frac{1}{S}\sum_{k=1}^{S}(y_{k}-\hat{y}_{k})^{2}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mi>MSE</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>S</mi></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><munderover><mo movablelimits="false" rspace="0em">∑</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>S</mi></munderover><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>y</mi><mi>k</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>k</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{MSE}}=\frac{1}{S}\sum_{k=1}^{S}(y_{k}-\hat{y}_{k})^{2}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(52)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A3.SS1.p1.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS1.p1.2.1" class="ltx_text">We compute the derivative with respect to the attention logit <math id="A3.SS1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="z_{si}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">z_{si}</annotation></semantics></math> using the chain rule:</span></p>
<table id="A3.E53" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>

</table>

<p id="A3.SS1.p1.4" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS1.p1.4.1" class="ltx_text">The derivative of the prediction <math id="A3.SS1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\hat{y}_{k}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>k</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\hat{y}_{k}</annotation></semantics></math> w.r.t. the logit <math id="A3.SS1.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="z_{si}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">z_{si}</annotation></semantics></math> is non-zero only if <math id="A3.SS1.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="k=s" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>s</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k=s</annotation></semantics></math>.
