<section id="A3.SS2" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">C.2 </span>Proof of Corollary <a href="#S2.Thmcorollary1" title="Corollary 2.1 (PCC/MSE Gradient Ratio Decay). ‣ Gradient Decomposition and the Optimization Conflict. ‣ 2.3 Optimization Dynamics: The Correlation Gradient Bottleneck ‣ 2 Theoretical Analysis of Correlation Learning in Attention-based Aggregation ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.1</span></a> (PCC/MSE Gradient Ratio Decay)</h3>

<div id="A3.SS2.2" class="ltx_proof">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_font_italic ltx_title_proof">Proof.</h6>
<div id="A3.SS2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text">We analyze the ratio of the global scaling factors <math id="A3.SS2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="g_{s}^{\mathrm{MSE}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi>g</mi><mi>s</mi><mi>MSE</mi></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">g_{s}^{\mathrm{MSE}}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A3.SS2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="g_{s}^{\mathrm{PCC}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi>g</mi><mi>s</mi><mi>PCC</mi></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">g_{s}^{\mathrm{PCC}}</annotation></semantics></math> identified in Section <a href="#S2.SS3" title="2.3 Optimization Dynamics: The Correlation Gradient Bottleneck ‣ 2 Theoretical Analysis of Correlation Learning in Attention-based Aggregation ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.3</span></a>:</span></p>
<table id="A3.EGx30" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A3.E57"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E57.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle g_{s}^{\mathrm{MSE}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi>g</mi><mi>s</mi><mi>MSE</mi></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle g_{s}^{\mathrm{MSE}}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E57.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=2(\hat{y}_{s}-y_{s})," display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>y</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=2(\hat{y}_{s}-y_{s}),</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(57)</span></td></tr></tbody>
<tbody id="A3.E58"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E58.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle g_{s}^{\mathrm{PCC}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi>g</mi><mi>s</mi><mi>PCC</mi></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle g_{s}^{\mathrm{PCC}}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E58.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\frac{1}{\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\left(\frac{a_{s}}{\sigma_{y}}-\rho\frac{b_{s}}{\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\right)." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mfrac></mstyle><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><msub><mi>a</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub></mfrac></mstyle><mo>−</mo><mrow><mi>ρ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><msub><mi>b</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mfrac></mstyle></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\frac{1}{\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\left(\frac{a_{s}}{\sigma_{y}}-\rho\frac{b_{s}}{\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\right).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(58)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A3.SS2.p1.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.p1.2.1" class="ltx_text">We analyze their typical scale across samples using their Root Mean Square (RMS) values. We denote the empirical average over the batch as <math id="A3.SS2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbb{E}_{s}[\cdot]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>𝔼</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">⋅</mo><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbb{E}_{s}[\cdot]</annotation></semantics></math>.</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<section id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px1" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Step 1: RMS scale of the PCC global factor.</h5>

<div id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We define normalized variables <math id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="A_{s}:=a_{s}/\sigma_{y}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>:=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>a</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>/</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A_{s}:=a_{s}/\sigma_{y}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="B_{s}:=b_{s}/\sigma_{\hat{y}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>B</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>:=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>b</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>/</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">B_{s}:=b_{s}/\sigma_{\hat{y}}</annotation></semantics></math>. By construction, <math id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="A_{s}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A_{s}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="B_{s}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>B</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">B_{s}</annotation></semantics></math> have zero mean and unit variance (<math id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\operatorname{Var}(A_{s})=\operatorname{Var}(B_{s})=1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>Var</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>Var</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>B</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{Var}(A_{s})=\operatorname{Var}(B_{s})=1</annotation></semantics></math>), and their covariance is the PCC (<math id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\operatorname{Cov}(A_{s},B_{s})=\rho" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>Cov</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>B</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>ρ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{Cov}(A_{s},B_{s})=\rho</annotation></semantics></math>).
The term inside the parenthesis of <math id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="g_{s}^{\mathrm{PCC}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi>g</mi><mi>s</mi><mi>PCC</mi></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">g_{s}^{\mathrm{PCC}}</annotation></semantics></math> is <math id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="A_{s}-\rho B_{s}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><mrow><mi>ρ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>B</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A_{s}-\rho B_{s}</annotation></semantics></math>. Its variance is:</p>
<table id="A3.EGx31" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A3.E59"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E59.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\operatorname{Var}(A_{s}-\rho B_{s})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>Var</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><mrow><mi>ρ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>B</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\operatorname{Var}(A_{s}-\rho B_{s})</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E59.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\operatorname{Var}(A_{s})+\rho^{2}\operatorname{Var}(B_{s})-2\rho\,\operatorname{Cov}(A_{s},B_{s})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>Var</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><msup><mi>ρ</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mi>Var</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>B</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>ρ</mi><mo lspace="0.337em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mi>Cov</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>B</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\operatorname{Var}(A_{s})+\rho^{2}\operatorname{Var}(B_{s})-2\rho\,\operatorname{Cov}(A_{s},B_{s})</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(59)</span></td></tr></tbody>
<tbody id="A3.E60"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_eqn_cell"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E60.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=1+\rho^{2}-2\rho^{2}=1-\rho^{2}." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>ρ</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi>ρ</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>ρ</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=1+\rho^{2}-2\rho^{2}=1-\rho^{2}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(60)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.2" class="ltx_p">Since the mean of <math id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="A_{s}-\rho B_{s}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><mrow><mi>ρ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>B</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A_{s}-\rho B_{s}</annotation></semantics></math> is zero, the RMS magnitude of <math id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="g_{s}^{\mathrm{PCC}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi>g</mi><mi>s</mi><mi>PCC</mi></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">g_{s}^{\mathrm{PCC}}</annotation></semantics></math> across samples is:</p>
<table id="A3.E61" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A3.E61.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\operatorname{RMS}_{s}(g_{s}^{\mathrm{PCC}})=\sqrt{\mathbb{E}_{s}[(g_{s}^{\mathrm{PCC}})^{2}]}=\frac{1}{\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\sqrt{\operatorname{Var}(A_{s}-\rho B_{s})}=\frac{\sqrt{1-\rho^{2}}}{\sigma_{\hat{y}}}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>RMS</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msubsup><mi>g</mi><mi>s</mi><mi>PCC</mi></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mrow><msub><mi>𝔼</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msubsup><mi>g</mi><mi>s</mi><mi>PCC</mi></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow></msqrt><mo>=</mo><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mrow><mi>Var</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><mrow><mi>ρ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>B</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></msqrt></mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac><msqrt><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>ρ</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></msqrt><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mfrac></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{RMS}_{s}(g_{s}^{\mathrm{PCC}})=\sqrt{\mathbb{E}_{s}[(g_{s}^{\mathrm{PCC}})^{2}]}=\frac{1}{\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\sqrt{\operatorname{Var}(A_{s}-\rho B_{s})}=\frac{\sqrt{1-\rho^{2}}}{\sigma_{\hat{y}}}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(61)</span></td></tr></tbody>

<section id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3" class="ltx_paragraph">

<div id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The ratio <math id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="r_{\mathrm{global}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>global</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">r_{\mathrm{global}}</annotation></semantics></math> is defined as:</p>
<table id="A3.E64" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">

<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(64)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.2" class="ltx_p">We use the MSE decomposition (Theorem <a href="#S2.Thmproposition1" title="Proposition 2.1 (MSE Mean–std–correlation Decomposition). ‣ 2.2 Preliminaries: The Interplay Between MSE and PCC ‣ 2 Theoretical Analysis of Correlation Learning in Attention-based Aggregation ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.1</span></a>):</p>

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A3.E65.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\operatorname{MSE}(\mathbf{y},\hat{\mathbf{y}})=(\mu_{\hat{\mathbf{y}}}-\mu_{\mathbf{y}})^{2}+(\sigma_{\hat{\mathbf{y}}}-\sigma_{\mathbf{y}})^{2}+2\,\sigma_{\mathbf{y}}\sigma_{\hat{\mathbf{y}}}(1-\rho)." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>MSE</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>𝐲</mi><mo>,</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐲</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>μ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐲</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mi>𝐲</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐲</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>𝐲</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>𝐲</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐲</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>ρ</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{MSE}(\mathbf{y},\hat{\mathbf{y}})=(\mu_{\hat{\mathbf{y}}}-\mu_{\mathbf{y}})^{2}+(\sigma_{\hat{\mathbf{y}}}-\sigma_{\mathbf{y}})^{2}+2\,\sigma_{\mathbf{y}}\sigma_{\hat{\mathbf{y}}}(1-\rho).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(65)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.3" class="ltx_p">Since all terms are non-negative, we obtain a lower bound for MSE:</p>
<table id="A3.E66" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A3.E66.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\operatorname{MSE}(\mathbf{y},\hat{\mathbf{y}})\geq 2\,\sigma_{y}\,\sigma_{\hat{y}}(1-\rho)." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>MSE</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>𝐲</mi><mo>,</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐲</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≥</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>ρ</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{MSE}(\mathbf{y},\hat{\mathbf{y}})\geq 2\,\sigma_{y}\,\sigma_{\hat{y}}(1-\rho).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(66)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.4" class="ltx_p">We assume <math id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\rho\in[0,1]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>ρ</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\rho\in[0,1]</annotation></semantics></math>, which is typical during training. We use the inequality:</p>
<table id="A3.E67" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A3.E67.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1-\rho^{2}=(1-\rho)(1+\rho)\leq 2(1-\rho)\implies\sqrt{1-\rho^{2}}\leq\sqrt{2}\sqrt{1-\rho}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>ρ</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>ρ</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>ρ</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>ρ</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟹</mo><msqrt><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>ρ</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></msqrt><mo>≤</mo><mrow><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>ρ</mi></mrow></msqrt></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1-\rho^{2}=(1-\rho)(1+\rho)\leq 2(1-\rho)\implies\sqrt{1-\rho^{2}}\leq\sqrt{2}\sqrt{1-\rho}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(67)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.5" class="ltx_p">Plugging the bounds from equation <a href="#A3.E66" title="Equation 66 ‣ Step 3: Bounding the ratio of RMS global factors. ‣ C.2 Proof of Corollary (PCC/MSE Gradient Ratio Decay) ‣ Appendix C Proofs for Optimization Dynamics Analysis ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">66</span></a> and equation <a href="#A3.E67" title="Equation 67 ‣ Step 3: Bounding the ratio of RMS global factors. ‣ C.2 Proof of Corollary (PCC/MSE Gradient Ratio Decay) ‣ Appendix C Proofs for Optimization Dynamics Analysis ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">67</span></a> into the ratio definition equation <a href="#A3.E64" title="Equation 64 ‣ Step 3: Bounding the ratio of RMS global factors. ‣ C.2 Proof of Corollary (PCC/MSE Gradient Ratio Decay) ‣ Appendix C Proofs for Optimization Dynamics Analysis ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">64</span></a>:</p>
<table id="A3.EGx33" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A3.E68"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E68.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle r_{\mathrm{global}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>global</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle r_{\mathrm{global}}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E68.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\leq\frac{\sqrt{2}\sqrt{1-\rho}}{2\sigma_{\hat{y}}\sqrt{2\sigma_{y}\sigma_{\hat{y}}(1-\rho)}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>≤</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>ρ</mi></mrow></msqrt></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>ρ</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></msqrt></mrow></mfrac></mstyle></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\leq\frac{\sqrt{2}\sqrt{1-\rho}}{2\sigma_{\hat{y}}\sqrt{2\sigma_{y}\sigma_{\hat{y}}(1-\rho)}}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(68)</span></td></tr></tbody>
<tbody id="A3.E69"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_eqn_cell"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E69.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\frac{\sqrt{2}\sqrt{1-\rho}}{2\sigma_{\hat{y}}\cdot\sqrt{2}\sqrt{\sigma_{y}\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\sqrt{1-\rho}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>ρ</mi></mrow></msqrt></mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mrow><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">⋅</mo><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mrow></msqrt><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>ρ</mi></mrow></msqrt></mrow></mfrac></mstyle></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\frac{\sqrt{2}\sqrt{1-\rho}}{2\sigma_{\hat{y}}\cdot\sqrt{2}\sqrt{\sigma_{y}\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\sqrt{1-\rho}}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(69)</span></td></tr></tbody>
<tbody id="A3.E70"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_eqn_cell"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E70.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\frac{1}{2\sigma_{\hat{y}}\sqrt{\sigma_{y}\sigma_{\hat{y}}}}=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{\sigma_{y}}}\cdot\frac{1}{\sigma_{\hat{y}}^{3/2}}." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mrow></msqrt></mrow></mfrac></mstyle><mo>=</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub></msqrt></mrow></mfrac></mstyle><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">⋅</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><msubsup><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>/</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msubsup></mfrac></mstyle></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\frac{1}{2\sigma_{\hat{y}}\sqrt{\sigma_{y}\sigma_{\hat{y}}}}=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{\sigma_{y}}}\cdot\frac{1}{\sigma_{\hat{y}}^{3/2}}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(70)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.6" class="ltx_p">This completes the proof.
∎</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS3" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">C.3 </span>Derivation of the Gradient Magnitude Bound</h3>

<div id="A3.Thmlemma1" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_lemma">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="A3.Thmlemma1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Lemma C.1</span></span><span id="A3.Thmlemma1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold"> </span>(Within-sample Dispersion Bound)<span id="A3.Thmlemma1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">.</span></h6>
<div id="A3.Thmlemma1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.Thmlemma1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.Thmlemma1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Recall the definitions <math id="A3.Thmlemma1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{\mu}_{s}=\tfrac{1}{n_{s}}\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\mathbf{h}_{sj}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>𝛍</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><msubsup><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></msubsup><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{\mu}_{s}=\tfrac{1}{n_{s}}\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\mathbf{h}_{sj}</annotation></semantics></math> (within-sample mean) and
<math id="A3.Thmlemma1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sigma_{s}^{2}=\tfrac{1}{n_{s}}\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\|\mathbf{h}_{sj}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mi>σ</mi><mi>s</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup><mo>=</mo><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><msubsup><mo rspace="0em">∑</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></msubsup><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝛍</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sigma_{s}^{2}=\tfrac{1}{n_{s}}\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\|\mathbf{h}_{sj}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|^{2}</annotation></semantics></math> (within-sample variance).
Also recall <math id="A3.Thmlemma1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{v}_{s}=\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\alpha_{sj}\mathbf{h}_{sj}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo rspace="0.111em">=</mo><mrow><msubsup><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></msubsup><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{v}_{s}=\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\alpha_{sj}\mathbf{h}_{sj}</annotation></semantics></math> where <math id="A3.Thmlemma1.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha_{sj}\geq 0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo>≥</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha_{sj}\geq 0</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A3.Thmlemma1.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sum_{j}\alpha_{sj}=1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mo>∑</mo><mi>j</mi></msub><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sum_{j}\alpha_{sj}=1</annotation></semantics></math>.
Then for every <math id="A3.Thmlemma1.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="i\in\{1,\dots,n_{s}\}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">i\in\{1,\dots,n_{s}\}</annotation></semantics></math>,</span></p>
<table id="A3.Ex1" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A3.Ex1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\|\mathbf{h}_{si}-\mathbf{v}_{s}\|\;\leq\;2\sqrt{n_{s}}\,\sigma_{s}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo rspace="0.280em" stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mn> 2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></msqrt><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\|\mathbf{h}_{si}-\mathbf{v}_{s}\|\;\leq\;2\sqrt{n_{s}}\,\sigma_{s}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS3.2" class="ltx_proof">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_font_italic ltx_title_proof">Proof.</h6>
<div id="A3.SS3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text">Fix sample <math id="A3.SS3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>s</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s</annotation></semantics></math> and index <math id="A3.SS3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="i" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>i</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">i</annotation></semantics></math>. We use the triangle inequality by inserting the within-sample mean <math id="A3.SS3.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{\mu}_{s}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{\mu}_{s}</annotation></semantics></math>:</span></p>
<table id="A3.EGx34" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A3.E71"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E71.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\|\mathbf{h}_{si}-\mathbf{v}_{s}\|=\|\mathbf{h}_{si}-\bm{\mu}_{s}+\bm{\mu}_{s}-\mathbf{v}_{s}\|\;\leq\;\|\mathbf{h}_{si}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|+\|\mathbf{v}_{s}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo rspace="0.280em" stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo rspace="0.558em">≤</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\|\mathbf{h}_{si}-\mathbf{v}_{s}\|=\|\mathbf{h}_{si}-\bm{\mu}_{s}+\bm{\mu}_{s}-\mathbf{v}_{s}\|\;\leq\;\|\mathbf{h}_{si}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|+\|\mathbf{v}_{s}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(71)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS3.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS3.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS3.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text">We bound each term on the right-hand side separately.</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<section id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px1" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Term 1: <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\|\mathbf{h}_{si}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\|\mathbf{h}_{si}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|</annotation></semantics></math>.</h5>

<div id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We first bound the deviation by the maximum deviation within the sample:</p>
<table id="A3.EGx35" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A3.E72"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E72.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\|\mathbf{h}_{si}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|\;\leq\;\max_{j}\|\mathbf{h}_{sj}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo rspace="0.280em" stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo rspace="0.558em">≤</mo><mrow><munder><mi>max</mi><mi>j</mi></munder><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\|\mathbf{h}_{si}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|\;\leq\;\max_{j}\|\mathbf{h}_{sj}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(72)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.2" class="ltx_p">The maximum of non-negative numbers is bounded by the square root of the sum of their squares (i.e., <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x_{k}^{2}\leq\sum_{j}x_{j}^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mi>x</mi><mi>k</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup><mo rspace="0.111em">≤</mo><mrow><msub><mo>∑</mo><mi>j</mi></msub><msubsup><mi>x</mi><mi>j</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x_{k}^{2}\leq\sum_{j}x_{j}^{2}</annotation></semantics></math> implies <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x_{k}\leq\sqrt{\sum_{j}x_{j}^{2}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>x</mi><mi>k</mi></msub><mo>≤</mo><msqrt><mrow><msub><mo>∑</mo><mi>j</mi></msub><msubsup><mi>x</mi><mi>j</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow></msqrt></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x_{k}\leq\sqrt{\sum_{j}x_{j}^{2}}</annotation></semantics></math>):</p>
<table id="A3.EGx36" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A3.E73"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E73.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\max_{j}\|\mathbf{h}_{sj}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|\;\leq\;\sqrt{\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\|\mathbf{h}_{sj}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|^{2}}." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><munder><mi>max</mi><mi>j</mi></munder><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo rspace="0.280em" stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="0.558em">≤</mo><msqrt><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><munderover><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></munderover></mstyle><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></msqrt></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\max_{j}\|\mathbf{h}_{sj}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|\;\leq\;\sqrt{\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\|\mathbf{h}_{sj}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|^{2}}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(73)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.3" class="ltx_p">By the definition of <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sigma_{s}^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi>σ</mi><mi>s</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sigma_{s}^{2}</annotation></semantics></math>, the sum of squares is <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n_{s}\sigma_{s}^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>σ</mi><mi>s</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n_{s}\sigma_{s}^{2}</annotation></semantics></math>. Thus,</p>
<table id="A3.EGx37" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A3.E74"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E74.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\|\mathbf{h}_{si}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|\;\leq\;\sqrt{n_{s}\sigma_{s}^{2}}=\sqrt{n_{s}}\,\sigma_{s}." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo rspace="0.280em" stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo rspace="0.558em">≤</mo><msqrt><mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>σ</mi><mi>s</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow></msqrt><mo>=</mo><mrow><msqrt><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></msqrt><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\|\mathbf{h}_{si}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|\;\leq\;\sqrt{n_{s}\sigma_{s}^{2}}=\sqrt{n_{s}}\,\sigma_{s}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(74)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px2" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Term 2: <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\|\mathbf{v}_{s}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\|\mathbf{v}_{s}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|</annotation></semantics></math>.</h5>

<div id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We express the deviation of the aggregated embedding <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{v}_{s}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{v}_{s}</annotation></semantics></math> from the mean <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{\mu}_{s}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{\mu}_{s}</annotation></semantics></math>. Since <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sum_{j}\alpha_{sj}=1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mo>∑</mo><mi>j</mi></msub><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sum_{j}\alpha_{sj}=1</annotation></semantics></math>, we have <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{\mu}_{s}=\sum_{j}\alpha_{sj}\bm{\mu}_{s}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo rspace="0.111em">=</mo><mrow><msub><mo>∑</mo><mi>j</mi></msub><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{\mu}_{s}=\sum_{j}\alpha_{sj}\bm{\mu}_{s}</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
<table id="A3.EGx38" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A3.E75"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E75.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\mathbf{v}_{s}-\bm{\mu}_{s}=\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\alpha_{sj}\mathbf{h}_{sj}-\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\alpha_{sj}\bm{\mu}_{s}=\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\alpha_{sj}(\mathbf{h}_{sj}-\bm{\mu}_{s})." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><munderover><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></munderover></mstyle><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><munderover><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></munderover></mstyle><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><munderover><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></munderover></mstyle><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\mathbf{v}_{s}-\bm{\mu}_{s}=\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\alpha_{sj}\mathbf{h}_{sj}-\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\alpha_{sj}\bm{\mu}_{s}=\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\alpha_{sj}(\mathbf{h}_{sj}-\bm{\mu}_{s}).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(75)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.2" class="ltx_p">Using the convexity of the norm (Jensen’s inequality):</p>
<table id="A3.EGx39" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A3.E76"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E76.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\|\mathbf{v}_{s}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|=\Big\|\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\alpha_{sj}(\mathbf{h}_{sj}-\bm{\mu}_{s})\Big\|\;\leq\;\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\alpha_{sj}\,\|\mathbf{h}_{sj}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em" stretchy="true">‖</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><munderover><mo stretchy="true">‖</mo></mrow><mo rspace="0.558em">≤</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><munderover><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></munderover></mstyle><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\|\mathbf{v}_{s}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|=\Big\|\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\alpha_{sj}(\mathbf{h}_{sj}-\bm{\mu}_{s})\Big\|\;\leq\;\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\alpha_{sj}\,\|\mathbf{h}_{sj}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(76)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.3" class="ltx_p">This weighted average is bounded by the maximum element:</p>
<table id="A3.EGx40" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A3.E77"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E77.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\alpha_{sj}\,\|\mathbf{h}_{sj}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|\;\leq\;\max_{j}\|\mathbf{h}_{sj}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><munderover><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></munderover></mstyle><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo rspace="0.280em" stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="0.558em">≤</mo><mrow><munder><mi>max</mi><mi>j</mi></munder><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\sum_{j=1}^{n_{s}}\alpha_{sj}\,\|\mathbf{h}_{sj}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|\;\leq\;\max_{j}\|\mathbf{h}_{sj}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(77)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.4" class="ltx_p">As established for Term 1 (<a href="#A3.E74" title="In Term 1: ‖𝐡_{𝑠⁢𝑖}-𝝁_𝑠‖. ‣ C.3 Derivation of the Gradient Magnitude Bound ‣ Appendix C Proofs for Optimization Dynamics Analysis ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Equation</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">74</span></a>), the maximum deviation is bounded by <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sqrt{n_{s}}\,\sigma_{s}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msqrt><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></msqrt><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sqrt{n_{s}}\,\sigma_{s}</annotation></semantics></math>. Therefore,</p>
<table id="A3.EGx41" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A3.E78"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E78.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\|\mathbf{v}_{s}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|\;\leq\;\sqrt{n_{s}}\,\sigma_{s}." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo rspace="0.280em" stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo rspace="0.558em">≤</mo><mrow><msqrt><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></msqrt><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\|\mathbf{v}_{s}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\|\;\leq\;\sqrt{n_{s}}\,\sigma_{s}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(78)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>

</section>
<section id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Conclusion.</h5>

<div id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Substituting the bounds from  <a href="#A3.E74" title="In Term 1: ‖𝐡_{𝑠⁢𝑖}-𝝁_𝑠‖. ‣ C.3 Derivation of the Gradient Magnitude Bound ‣ Appendix C Proofs for Optimization Dynamics Analysis ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Equation</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">74</span></a> and  <a href="#A3.E78" title="In Term 2: ‖𝐯_𝑠-𝝁_𝑠‖. ‣ C.3 Derivation of the Gradient Magnitude Bound ‣ Appendix C Proofs for Optimization Dynamics Analysis ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Equation</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">78</span></a> into  <a href="#A3.E71" title="In Proof. ‣ C.3 Derivation of the Gradient Magnitude Bound ‣ Appendix C Proofs for Optimization Dynamics Analysis ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Equation</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">71</span></a>:</p>
<table id="A3.Ex2" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A3.Ex2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\|\mathbf{h}_{si}-\mathbf{v}_{s}\|\;\leq\;\sqrt{n_{s}}\,\sigma_{s}+\sqrt{n_{s}}\,\sigma_{s}\;=\;2\sqrt{n_{s}}\,\sigma_{s}.\qed" display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo rspace="0.280em" stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo rspace="0.558em">≤</mo><mrow><mrow><msqrt><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></msqrt><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><msqrt><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></msqrt><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mn> 2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></msqrt><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.0835em">.</mo><mo class="ltx_mathvariant_italic" lspace="0.0835em" mathvariant="italic" separator="true">∎</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\|\mathbf{h}_{si}-\mathbf{v}_{s}\|\;\leq\;\sqrt{n_{s}}\,\sigma_{s}+\sqrt{n_{s}}\,\sigma_{s}\;=\;2\sqrt{n_{s}}\,\sigma_{s}.\qed</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div id="A3.Thmlemma2" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_lemma">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="A3.Thmlemma2.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Lemma C.2</span></span><span id="A3.Thmlemma2.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold"> </span>(Magnitude Bound of a Centered, Unit-variance Vector)<span id="A3.Thmlemma2.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">.</span></h6>
<div id="A3.Thmlemma2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.Thmlemma2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.Thmlemma2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Let <math id="A3.Thmlemma2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x_{1},\dots,x_{S}\in\mathbb{R}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><msub><mi>x</mi><mi>S</mi></msub><mo>∈</mo><mi>ℝ</mi></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x_{1},\dots,x_{S}\in\mathbb{R}</annotation></semantics></math> satisfy <math id="A3.Thmlemma2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sum_{s=1}^{S}x_{s}=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msubsup><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>S</mi></msubsup><msub><mi>x</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sum_{s=1}^{S}x_{s}=0</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A3.Thmlemma2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\frac{1}{S}\sum_{s=1}^{S}x_{s}^{2}=1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>S</mi></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><msubsup><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>S</mi></msubsup><msubsup><mi>x</mi><mi>s</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{1}{S}\sum_{s=1}^{S}x_{s}^{2}=1</annotation></semantics></math> (equivalently <math id="A3.Thmlemma2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sum_{s=1}^{S}x_{s}^{2}=S" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msubsup><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>S</mi></msubsup><msubsup><mi>x</mi><mi>s</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>S</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sum_{s=1}^{S}x_{s}^{2}=S</annotation></semantics></math>). Then for every <math id="A3.Thmlemma2.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="j\in\{1,\dots,S\}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>S</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">j\in\{1,\dots,S\}</annotation></semantics></math>, we have <math id="A3.Thmlemma2.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="|x_{j}|\leq\sqrt{S-1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mi>j</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo>≤</mo><msqrt><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msqrt></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">|x_{j}|\leq\sqrt{S-1}</annotation></semantics></math>.</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.1" class="ltx_proof">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_font_italic ltx_title_proof">Proof.</h6>
<div id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text">Fix an index <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="j" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>j</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">j</annotation></semantics></math>. Since the vector is centered (<math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sum_{s=1}^{S}x_{s}=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msubsup><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>S</mi></msubsup><msub><mi>x</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sum_{s=1}^{S}x_{s}=0</annotation></semantics></math>), we can express <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x_{j}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>x</mi><mi>j</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x_{j}</annotation></semantics></math> in terms of the other elements: <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p2.m4" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="x_{j}=-\sum_{s\neq j}x_{s}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><msub><mrow></mrow><mi>j</mi></msub><mo rspace="0em">=</mo><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0.055em">−</mo><mo>∑</mo><msub><mrow></mrow><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>≠</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mi>x</mi><msub><mrow></mrow><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x_{j}=-\sum_{s\neq j}x_{s}</annotation></semantics></math>.
We analyze the squared magnitude <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p2.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x_{j}^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi>x</mi><mi>j</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x_{j}^{2}</annotation></semantics></math> using the Cauchy–Schwarz inequality and view the summation as a dot product between a vector of ones <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p2.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{1}\in\mathbb{R}^{S-1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>𝟏</mn><mo>∈</mo><msup><mi>ℝ</mi><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{1}\in\mathbb{R}^{S-1}</annotation></semantics></math> and the vector <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p2.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(x_{s})_{s\neq j}\in\mathbb{R}^{S-1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>≠</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><mo>∈</mo><msup><mi>ℝ</mi><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(x_{s})_{s\neq j}\in\mathbb{R}^{S-1}</annotation></semantics></math>.</span></p>
<table id="A3.EGx42" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A3.E79"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">

rspace="0.222em">⋅</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mrow><mo maxsize="1.600em" movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>≠</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></munder></mstyle><msubsup><mi>x</mi><mi>s</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" j}x_{s}^{2}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>

</table>
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p2.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p2.2.1" class="ltx_text">We use the unit-variance condition, <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p2.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sum_{s=1}^{S}x_{s}^{2}=S" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msubsup><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>S</mi></msubsup><msubsup><mi>x</mi><mi>s</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>S</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sum_{s=1}^{S}x_{s}^{2}=S</annotation></semantics></math>. Therefore, <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p2.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sum_{s\neq j}x_{s}^{2}=S-x_{j}^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>≠</mo><mi>j</mi></mrow></msub><msubsup><mi>x</mi><mi>s</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo>−</mo><msubsup><mi>x</mi><mi>j</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sum_{s\neq j}x_{s}^{2}=S-x_{j}^{2}</annotation></semantics></math>. Substituting this into the inequality:</span></p>
<table id="A3.EGx43" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A3.E80"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">

<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E80.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\leq(S-1)\bigl(S-x_{j}^{2}\bigr)=S(S-1)-(S-1)x_{j}^{2}." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">(</mo><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo>−</mo><msubsup><mi>x</mi><mi>j</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mi>x</mi><mi>j</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\leq(S-1)\bigl(S-x_{j}^{2}\bigr)=S(S-1)-(S-1)x_{j}^{2}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>

</table>
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p2.3" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p2.3.1" class="ltx_text">Rearranging the terms to isolate <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p2.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x_{j}^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi>x</mi><mi>j</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x_{j}^{2}</annotation></semantics></math>:</span></p>

<p id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p2.4" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p2.4.1" class="ltx_text">Dividing by <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p2.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="S" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>S</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">S</annotation></semantics></math> (which is positive) gives <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p2.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x_{j}^{2}\leq S-1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mi>x</mi><mi>j</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x_{j}^{2}\leq S-1</annotation></semantics></math>. Taking the square root yields the desired bound:</span></p>

<div id="A3.Thmcorollary1" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_corollary">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="A3.Thmcorollary1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Corollary C.1</span></span><span id="A3.Thmcorollary1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold"> </span>(Gradient Magnitude Bound)<span id="A3.Thmcorollary1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">.</span></h6>
<div id="A3.Thmcorollary1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.Thmcorollary1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.Thmcorollary1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">The magnitude of the PCC gradient in <a href="#S2.Thmtheorem1" title="Theorem 2.1 (Gradient of PCC w.r.t. Attention Logits). ‣ 2.3 Optimization Dynamics: The Correlation Gradient Bottleneck ‣ 2 Theoretical Analysis of Correlation Learning in Attention-based Aggregation ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Theorem</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2.1</span></a> can be bounded by</span></p>
<table id="A3.EGx45" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A3.E83"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E83.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\left|\frac{\partial\rho}{\partial z_{si}}\right|\leq\frac{1}{\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\frac{4\sqrt{n_{s}(S-1)}}{S}\|\mathbf{w}\|\sigma_{s}." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mo>∂</mo><mi>ρ</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mfrac></mstyle><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></msqrt></mrow><mi>S</mi></mfrac></mstyle><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝐰</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\left|\frac{\partial\rho}{\partial z_{si}}\right|\leq\frac{1}{\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\frac{4\sqrt{n_{s}(S-1)}}{S}\|\mathbf{w}\|\sigma_{s}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(83)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.2" class="ltx_proof">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_font_italic ltx_title_proof">Proof.</h6>
<div id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text">We start from the expression for the PCC gradient derived in <a href="#A2.Thmtheorem1" title="Theorem B.1 (Gradient of PCC w.r.t. Attention Logits). ‣ B.1 Gradient of Pearson Correlation w.r.t. Attention Logits ‣ Appendix B Gradient Analysis of Correlation ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Theorem</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">B.1</span></a>:</span></p>
<table id="A3.E84" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>

<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(84)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p3.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p3.2.1" class="ltx_text">We analyze the magnitude of this expression by applying the triangle inequality and the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality (<math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="|\mathbf{w}^{\top}\mathbf{x}|\leq\|\mathbf{w}\|\|\mathbf{x}\|" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mrow><msup><mi>𝐰</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝐱</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝐰</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝐱</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">|\mathbf{w}^{\top}\mathbf{x}|\leq\|\mathbf{w}\|\|\mathbf{x}\|</annotation></semantics></math>):</span></p>

<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E85.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\leq\frac{|\alpha_{si}|}{S\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\left|\frac{a_{s}}{\sigma_{y}}-\rho\frac{b_{s}}{\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\right|\left|\mathbf{w}^{\top}(\mathbf{h}_{si}-\mathbf{v}_{s})\right|" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><msub><mi>a</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub></mfrac></mstyle><mo>−</mo><mrow><mi>ρ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><msub><mi>b</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mfrac></mstyle></mrow></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><msup><mi>𝐰</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\leq\frac{|\alpha_{si}|}{S\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\left|\frac{a_{s}}{\sigma_{y}}-\rho\frac{b_{s}}{\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\right|\left|\mathbf{w}^{\top}(\mathbf{h}_{si}-\mathbf{v}_{s})\right|</annotation></semantics></math></td>
