<div id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p4.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p4.1.1" class="ltx_text">We now bound the individual components.</span></p>
<ol id="A3.I1" class="ltx_enumerate">
<li id="A3.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">1.</span> 
<div id="A3.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Attention weight:</span> Since <math id="A3.I1.i1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha_{s}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>α</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha_{s}</annotation></semantics></math> is a probability from Softmax, <math id="A3.I1.i1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0\leq\alpha_{si}\leq 1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>≤</mo><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo>≤</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0\leq\alpha_{si}\leq 1</annotation></semantics></math></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">2.</span> 
<div id="A3.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.I1.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Correlation coefficient:</span> By definition, <math id="A3.I1.i2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="-1\leq\rho\leq 1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mi>ρ</mi><mo>≤</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">-1\leq\rho\leq 1</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math id="A3.I1.i2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="|\rho|\leq 1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi>ρ</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">|\rho|\leq 1</annotation></semantics></math></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">3.</span> 
<div id="A3.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.I1.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Standardized scores:</span> The terms <math id="A3.I1.i3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\frac{a_{s}}{\sigma_{y}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mfrac><msub><mi>a</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub></mfrac><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{a_{s}}{\sigma_{y}}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A3.I1.i3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\frac{b_{s}}{\sigma_{\hat{y}}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mfrac><msub><mi>b</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mfrac><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{b_{s}}{\sigma_{\hat{y}}}</annotation></semantics></math> are the standardized scores (z-scores) of the target and prediction for sample <math id="A3.I1.i3.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>s</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s</annotation></semantics></math>. They form centered, unit-variance vectors across the <math id="A3.I1.i3.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="S" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>S</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">S</annotation></semantics></math> samples. By applying <a href="#A3.Thmlemma2" title="Lemma C.2 (Magnitude Bound of a Centered, Unit-variance Vector). ‣ Conclusion. ‣ C.3 Derivation of the Gradient Magnitude Bound ‣ Appendix C Proofs for Optimization Dynamics Analysis ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Lemma</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">C.2</span></a>, we have:</p>
<table id="A3.Ex4" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A3.Ex4.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\left|\frac{a_{s}}{\sigma_{y}}\right|\leq\sqrt{S-1}\quad\text{and}\quad\left|\frac{b_{s}}{\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\right|\leq\sqrt{S-1}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mfrac><msub><mi>a</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub></mfrac><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>≤</mo><msqrt><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msqrt></mrow><mspace style="width:1em;" width="1em"></mspace><mtext>and</mtext><mspace style="width:1em;" width="1em"></mspace><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mfrac><msub><mi>b</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mfrac><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>≤</mo><msqrt><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msqrt></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\left|\frac{a_{s}}{\sigma_{y}}\right|\leq\sqrt{S-1}\quad\text{and}\quad\left|\frac{b_{s}}{\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\right|\leq\sqrt{S-1}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">4.</span> 
<div id="A3.I1.i4.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.I1.i4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Within-sample dispersion:</span> The term <math id="A3.I1.i4.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\|\mathbf{h}_{si}-\mathbf{v}_{s}\|" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\|\mathbf{h}_{si}-\mathbf{v}_{s}\|</annotation></semantics></math> represents the deviation of the embedding <math id="A3.I1.i4.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{h}_{si}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{h}_{si}</annotation></semantics></math> from the aggregated embedding <math id="A3.I1.i4.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{v}_{s}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{v}_{s}</annotation></semantics></math>. By applying <a href="#A3.Thmlemma1" title="Lemma C.1 (Within-sample Dispersion Bound). ‣ C.3 Derivation of the Gradient Magnitude Bound ‣ Appendix C Proofs for Optimization Dynamics Analysis ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Lemma</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">C.1</span></a>, we have:</p>
<table id="A3.Ex5" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A3.Ex5.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\|\mathbf{h}_{si}-\mathbf{v}_{s}\|\leq 2\sqrt{n_{s}}\,\sigma_{s}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></msqrt><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\|\mathbf{h}_{si}-\mathbf{v}_{s}\|\leq 2\sqrt{n_{s}}\,\sigma_{s}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div></li>
</ol>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p5.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p5.1.1" class="ltx_text">Substituting these bounds into the inequality:</span></p>
<table id="A3.EGx47" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A3.E87"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E87.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\left|\frac{\partial\rho}{\partial z_{si}}\right|" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>|</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mo>∂</mo><mi>ρ</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>∂</mo><msub><mi>z</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle><mo>|</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\left|\frac{\partial\rho}{\partial z_{si}}\right|</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E87.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\leq\frac{1}{S\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\left(\sqrt{S-1}+1\sqrt{S-1}\right)\|\mathbf{w}\|\,\left(2\sqrt{n_{s}}\sigma_{s}\right)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><msqrt><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msqrt><mo>+</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msqrt></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝐰</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></msqrt><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\leq\frac{1}{S\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\left(\sqrt{S-1}+1\sqrt{S-1}\right)\|\mathbf{w}\|\,\left(2\sqrt{n_{s}}\sigma_{s}\right)</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(87)</span></td></tr></tbody>
<tbody id="A3.E88"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_eqn_cell"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E88.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\frac{1}{S\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\left(2\sqrt{S-1}\right)\|\mathbf{w}\|\left(2\sqrt{n_{s}}\sigma_{s}\right)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msqrt></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝐰</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></msqrt><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\frac{1}{S\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\left(2\sqrt{S-1}\right)\|\mathbf{w}\|\left(2\sqrt{n_{s}}\sigma_{s}\right)</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(88)</span></td></tr></tbody>
<tbody id="A3.E89"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_eqn_cell"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.E89.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\frac{4\sqrt{n_{s}(S-1)}}{S\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\|\mathbf{w}\|\sigma_{s}." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msqrt><mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></msqrt></mrow><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub></mrow></mfrac></mstyle><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝐰</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>σ</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\frac{4\sqrt{n_{s}(S-1)}}{S\sigma_{\hat{y}}}\|\mathbf{w}\|\sigma_{s}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(89)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p6.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p6.1.1" class="ltx_text">Rearranging the terms to highlight the key factors identified in the main text:</span></p>
<table id="A3.E90" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A3.E90.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\left|\frac{\partial\rho}{\partial z_{si}}\right|\leq\underbrace{\frac{1}{\sigma_{\hat{y}}}}_{\begin{subarray}{c}\text{prediction}\\

\text{deviation}\end{subarray}}\!\!\!\!\!\cdot\underbrace{\frac{4\sqrt{n_{s}(S-1)}}{S}}_{\text{batch scale}}\cdot\!\!\!\underbrace{\|\mathbf{w}\|}_{\begin{subarray}{c}\text{regression}\\
\text{weights}\end{subarray}}\!\cdot\!\!\underbrace{\sigma_{s}}_{\begin{subarray}{c}\text{in-sample}\\

<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(90)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>

∎</span></p>

</section>
</section>
<section id="A4" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix D </span>Achievable PCC Bound of Convex Attention Models</h2>

<div id="A4.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">This section provides the detailed analysis and proof of an intrinsic upper bound on the PCC gain that any convex attention mechanism can achieve compared to a simple mean-pooling baseline. This analysis formalizes the capacity limitation imposed by the convex hull constraint.</p>
</div>
<section id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px1" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Setup and Decomposition.</h5>

<div id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We consider a dataset of <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="S" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>S</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">S</annotation></semantics></math> samples. For sample <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>s</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s</annotation></semantics></math>, we have element embeddings <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{h}_{s}=\{\mathbf{h}_{si}\}_{i=1}^{n_{s}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><msubsup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></msubsup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{h}_{s}=\{\mathbf{h}_{si}\}_{i=1}^{n_{s}}</annotation></semantics></math> where <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{h}_{si}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo>∈</mo><msup><mi>ℝ</mi><mi>d</mi></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{h}_{si}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}</annotation></semantics></math>. Let <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{\mu}_{s}:=\tfrac{1}{n_{s}}\sum_{i=1}^{n_{s}}\mathbf{h}_{si}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>:=</mo><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><msubsup><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></msubsup><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{\mu}_{s}:=\tfrac{1}{n_{s}}\sum_{i=1}^{n_{s}}\mathbf{h}_{si}</annotation></semantics></math> be the mean-pooling embedding.
A convex attention mechanism computes weights <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\{\alpha_{si}\}_{i=1}^{n_{s}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\{\alpha_{si}\}_{i=1}^{n_{s}}</annotation></semantics></math> such that <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha_{si}\geq 0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo>≥</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha_{si}\geq 0</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sum_{i}\alpha_{si}=1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mo>∑</mo><mi>i</mi></msub><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sum_{i}\alpha_{si}=1</annotation></semantics></math>. The aggregated embedding is <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{v}_{s}=\sum_{i}\alpha_{si}\mathbf{h}_{si}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo rspace="0.111em">=</mo><mrow><msub><mo>∑</mo><mi>i</mi></msub><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{v}_{s}=\sum_{i}\alpha_{si}\mathbf{h}_{si}</annotation></semantics></math>.
The prediction is given by a linear regression head <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(\mathbf{w},b)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>𝐰</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>b</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(\mathbf{w},b)</annotation></semantics></math>: <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\hat{y}_{s}=\mathbf{w}^{\top}\mathbf{v}_{s}+c" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><msup><mi>𝐰</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\hat{y}_{s}=\mathbf{w}^{\top}\mathbf{v}_{s}+c</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
<div id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p2.1" class="ltx_p">We decompose the prediction relative to the mean-pooling baseline:</p>
<table id="A4.E91" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.E91.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\hat{y}_{s}=\underbrace{(\mathbf{w}^{\top}\bm{\mu}_{s}+c)}_{\bar{y}_{s}}+\underbrace{\mathbf{w}^{\top}(\mathbf{v}_{s}-\bm{\mu}_{s})}_{\Delta\hat{y}_{s}}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><munder><munder accentunder="true"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mrow><msup><mi>𝐰</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="true">⏟</mo></munder><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>¯</mo></mover><mi>s</mi></msub></munder><mo>+</mo><munder><munder accentunder="true"><mrow><msup><mi>𝐰</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐯</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="true">⏟</mo></munder><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></munder></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\hat{y}_{s}=\underbrace{(\mathbf{w}^{\top}\bm{\mu}_{s}+c)}_{\bar{y}_{s}}+\underbrace{\mathbf{w}^{\top}(\mathbf{v}_{s}-\bm{\mu}_{s})}_{\Delta\hat{y}_{s}}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(91)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p2.2" class="ltx_p">Here, <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bar{y}_{s}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>¯</mo></mover><mi>s</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bar{y}_{s}</annotation></semantics></math> is the baseline prediction, and <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Delta\hat{y}_{s}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Delta\hat{y}_{s}</annotation></semantics></math> is the attention-induced perturbation.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px2" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Quantifying Dispersion and Variation.</h5>

<div id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We introduce measures for within-sample dispersion (related to in-sample homogeneity) and across-sample variation. Throughout this section, <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1.m1" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="\|\cdot\|_{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo rspace="0em">∥</mo><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">⋅</mo><mo lspace="0em">∥</mo><msub><mrow></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\|\cdot\|_{2}</annotation></semantics></math> denotes the <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\ell_{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">ℓ</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\ell_{2}</annotation></semantics></math> norm. We assume the empirical definition for standard deviation (normalized by <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1/S" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>/</mo><mi>S</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1/S</annotation></semantics></math>).</p>
</div>
<div id="A4.Thmdefinition1" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_definition">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="A4.Thmdefinition1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Definition D.1</span></span><span id="A4.Thmdefinition1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold"> </span>(Intrinsic Dispersion and Baseline Variation)<span id="A4.Thmdefinition1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">.</span></h6>
<div id="A4.Thmdefinition1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A4.Thmdefinition1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmdefinition1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">For each sample <math id="A4.Thmdefinition1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>s</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s</annotation></semantics></math>, define the maximum within-sample deviation (the radius of the convex hull centered at the mean):</span></p>
<table id="A4.E92" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.E92.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="R_{s}:=\max_{1\leq i\leq n_{s}}\big\|\,\mathbf{h}_{si}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\,\big\|_{2}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>R</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>:=</mo><mrow><munder><mi>max</mi><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>≤</mo><mi>i</mi><mo>≤</mo><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></munder><mo>⁡</mo><msub><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em" rspace="0.170em" stretchy="true">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐡</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em" stretchy="true">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R_{s}:=\max_{1\leq i\leq n_{s}}\big\|\,\mathbf{h}_{si}-\bm{\mu}_{s}\,\big\|_{2}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(92)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div id="A4.Thmdefinition1.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A4.Thmdefinition1.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmdefinition1.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Define the intrinsic within-sample dispersion <math id="A4.Thmdefinition1.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\tilde{R}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mover accent="true"><mi>R</mi><mo>~</mo></mover><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tilde{R}</annotation></semantics></math> as the root mean square (RMS) of these radii across the dataset:</span></p>
<table id="A4.E93" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.E93.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\tilde{R}:=\sqrt{\frac{1}{S}\sum_{s=1}^{S}R_{s}^{2}}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi>R</mi><mo>~</mo></mover><mo>:=</mo><msqrt><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>S</mi></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><munderover><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>S</mi></munderover><msubsup><mi>R</mi><mi>s</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow></mrow></msqrt></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tilde{R}:=\sqrt{\frac{1}{S}\sum_{s=1}^{S}R_{s}^{2}}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(93)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div id="A4.Thmdefinition1.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.Thmdefinition1.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmdefinition1.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Let <math id="A4.Thmdefinition1.p3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sigma_{0}:=\operatorname{std}_{s}\left(\bar{y}_{s}\right)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo>:=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>std</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>¯</mo></mover><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sigma_{0}:=\operatorname{std}_{s}\left(\bar{y}_{s}\right)</annotation></semantics></math> denote the standard deviation of the baseline predictions across samples.</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<div id="A4.Thmremark1" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_remark">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="A4.Thmremark1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Remark D.1</span></span><span id="A4.Thmremark1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">.</span></h6>
<div id="A4.Thmremark1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.Thmremark1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><math id="A4.Thmremark1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\tilde{R}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mover accent="true"><mi>R</mi><mo>~</mo></mover><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tilde{R}</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A4.Thmremark1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic"> measures the intrinsic homogeneity of the embeddings within samples, independent of the regression head <math id="A4.Thmremark1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{w}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>𝐰</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{w}</annotation></semantics></math>. <math id="A4.Thmremark1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sigma_{0}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>σ</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sigma_{0}</annotation></semantics></math> captures the variation of the mean embeddings projected onto the regression space. By the scaling property of the standard deviation, <math id="A4.Thmremark1.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sigma_{0}=\|\mathbf{w}\|_{2}\,\operatorname{std}_{s}\!\left(\hat{\mathbf{w}}^{\top}\bm{\mu}_{s}\right)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>σ</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝐰</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><msub><mi>std</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><msup><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐰</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>⊤</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>𝛍</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sigma_{0}=\|\mathbf{w}\|_{2}\,\operatorname{std}_{s}\!\left(\hat{\mathbf{w}}^{\top}\bm{\mu}_{s}\right)</annotation></semantics></math>, where <math id="A4.Thmremark1.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\hat{\mathbf{w}}:=\mathbf{w}/\|\mathbf{w}\|_{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐰</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>:=</mo><mrow><mi>𝐰</mi><mo>/</mo><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝐰</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\hat{\mathbf{w}}:=\mathbf{w}/\|\mathbf{w}\|_{2}</annotation></semantics></math>.</span></p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px3" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Centered Notation.</h5>

<div id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We define the vectors of predictions across the <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="S" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>S</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">S</annotation></semantics></math> samples: <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\hat{\mathbf{y}},\bar{\mathbf{y}},\Delta\hat{\mathbf{y}}\in\mathbb{R}^{S}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐲</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐲</mi><mo>¯</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐲</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow><mo>∈</mo><msup><mi>ℝ</mi><mi>S</mi></msup></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\hat{\mathbf{y}},\bar{\mathbf{y}},\Delta\hat{\mathbf{y}}\in\mathbb{R}^{S}</annotation></semantics></math>. From <a href="#A4.E91" title="In Setup and Decomposition. ‣ Appendix D Achievable PCC Bound of Convex Attention Models ‣ Breaking the Correlation Plateau: On the Optimization and Capacity Limits of Attention-Based Regressors" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Equation</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">91</span></a>, we have <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\hat{\mathbf{y}}=\bar{\mathbf{y}}+\Delta\hat{\mathbf{y}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐲</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐲</mi><mo>¯</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐲</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\hat{\mathbf{y}}=\bar{\mathbf{y}}+\Delta\hat{\mathbf{y}}</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
<div id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p2.1" class="ltx_p">We denote the centered versions of these vectors (by subtracting their respective means <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mu_{\hat{y}},\mu_{\bar{y}},\mu_{\Delta\hat{y}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>μ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>¯</mo></mover></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mu_{\hat{y}},\mu_{\bar{y}},\mu_{\Delta\hat{y}}</annotation></semantics></math>) as <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{b},\bar{\mathbf{b}},\Delta\mathbf{b}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝐛</mi><mo>,</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐛</mi><mo>¯</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝐛</mi></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{b},\bar{\mathbf{b}},\Delta\mathbf{b}</annotation></semantics></math>. By linearity, the decomposition holds for centered vectors: <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{b}=\bar{\mathbf{b}}+\Delta\mathbf{b}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝐛</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐛</mi><mo>¯</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝐛</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{b}=\bar{\mathbf{b}}+\Delta\mathbf{b}</annotation></semantics></math>.
We denote the centered ground-truth targets as <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p2.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{a}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>𝐚</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{a}</annotation></semantics></math>, where <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p2.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="a_{s}=y_{s}-\mu_{y}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>a</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>y</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>μ</mi><mi>y</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">a_{s}=y_{s}-\mu_{y}</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
<div id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3.1" class="ltx_p">The Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) is the cosine similarity between centered vectors. Let <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\rho=\operatorname{PCC}(\mathbf{a},\mathbf{b})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>ρ</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>PCC</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>𝐚</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>𝐛</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\rho=\operatorname{PCC}(\mathbf{a},\mathbf{b})</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\rho_{0}=\operatorname{PCC}(\mathbf{a},\bar{\mathbf{b}})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>ρ</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>PCC</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>𝐚</mi><mo>,</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐛</mi><mo>¯</mo></mover><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\rho_{0}=\operatorname{PCC}(\mathbf{a},\bar{\mathbf{b}})</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px4" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Bounding the Attention Perturbation.</h5>

<div id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We first establish bounds on the magnitude of the perturbation <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Delta\hat{\mathbf{y}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐲</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Delta\hat{\mathbf{y}}</annotation></semantics></math> and its centered counterpart <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Delta\mathbf{b}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝐛</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Delta\mathbf{b}</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
<div id="A4.Thmlemma1" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_lemma">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="A4.Thmlemma1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Lemma D.1</span></span><span id="A4.Thmlemma1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold"> </span>(Bound on Prediction Perturbation)<span id="A4.Thmlemma1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">.</span></h6>
<div id="A4.Thmlemma1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A4.Thmlemma1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmlemma1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">For any convex attention weights <math id="A4.Thmlemma1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\{\alpha_{si}\}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\{\alpha_{si}\}</annotation></semantics></math>, the perturbation for sample <math id="A4.Thmlemma1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>s</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s</annotation></semantics></math> is bounded by:</span></p>
<table id="A4.Ex6" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.Ex6.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="|\Delta\hat{y}_{s}|\leq\|\mathbf{w}\|_{2}\,R_{s}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mrow><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝐰</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>R</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">|\Delta\hat{y}_{s}|\leq\|\mathbf{w}\|_{2}\,R_{s}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A4.Thmlemma1.p1.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmlemma1.p1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">Consequently, the L2 norm of the centered perturbation vector is bounded by:</span></p>
<table id="A4.Ex7" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.Ex7.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\|\Delta\mathbf{b}\|_{2}\;\leq\;\sqrt{S}\,\|\mathbf{w}\|_{2}\,\tilde{R}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝐛</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0.558em" rspace="0.558em">≤</mo><mrow><msqrt><mi>S</mi></msqrt><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝐰</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>R</mi><mo>~</mo></mover></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\|\Delta\mathbf{b}\|_{2}\;\leq\;\sqrt{S}\,\|\mathbf{w}\|_{2}\,\tilde{R}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px4.1" class="ltx_proof">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_font_italic ltx_title_proof">Proof.</h6>
<div id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text">We analyze the perturbation term. Since <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sum_{i}\alpha_{si}=1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mo>∑</mo><mi>i</mi></msub><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sum_{i}\alpha_{si}=1</annotation></semantics></math>, we can write <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bm{\mu}_{s}=\sum_{i}\alpha_{si}\bm{\mu}_{s}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo rspace="0.111em">=</mo><mrow><msub><mo>∑</mo><mi>i</mi></msub><mrow><msub><mi>α</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>𝝁</mi><mi>s</mi></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bm{\mu}_{s}=\sum_{i}\alpha_{si}\bm{\mu}_{s}</annotation></semantics></math>.</span></p>
<table id="A4.Ex8" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.Ex8.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Delta\hat{y}_{s}=\mathbf{w}^{\top}(\mathbf{v}_{s}-\bm{\mu}_{s})=\mathbf{w}^{\top}\left(\sum_{i=1}^{n_{s}}\alpha_{si}\mathbf{h}_{si}-\sum_{i=1}^{n_{s}}\alpha_{si}\bm{\mu}_{s}\right)=\mathbf{w}^{\top}\sum_{i=1}^{n_{s}}\alpha_{si}(\mathbf{h}_{si}-\bm{\mu}_{s})." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mover </table>

<p id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p2.3" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p2.3.1" class="ltx_text">To bound the L2 norm of the uncentered perturbation vector <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Delta\hat{\mathbf{y}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐲</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Delta\hat{\mathbf{y}}</annotation></semantics></math>, we sum the squared bounds across samples:</span></p>

<p id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p2.4" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p2.4.1" class="ltx_text">Using the definition of the RMS dispersion <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p2.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\tilde{R}^{2}=\frac{1}{S}\sum_{s}R_{s}^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mover accent="true"><mi>R</mi><mo>~</mo></mover><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>S</mi></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><msub><mo>∑</mo><mi>s</mi></msub><msubsup><mi>R</mi><mi>s</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tilde{R}^{2}=\frac{1}{S}\sum_{s}R_{s}^{2}</annotation></semantics></math>, we get:</span></p>

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">

<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.Ex14.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\|\Delta\hat{\mathbf{y}}\|_{2}^{2}\leq S\,\|\mathbf{w}\|_{2}^{2}\,\tilde{R}^{2}\implies\|\Delta\hat{\mathbf{y}}\|_{2}\leq\sqrt{S}\,\|\mathbf{w}\|_{2}\,\tilde{R}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msubsup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐲</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn><mn>2</mn></msubsup><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msubsup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝐰</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn><mn>2</mn></msubsup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mover accent="true"><mi>R</mi><mo>~</mo></mover><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟹</mo><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐲</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>≤</mo><mrow><msqrt><mi>S</mi></msqrt><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝐰</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>R</mi><mo>~</mo></mover></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\|\Delta\hat{\mathbf{y}}\|_{2}^{2}\leq S\,\|\mathbf{w}\|_{2}^{2}\,\tilde{R}^{2}\implies\|\Delta\hat{\mathbf{y}}\|_{2}\leq\sqrt{S}\,\|\mathbf{w}\|_{2}\,\tilde{R}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p2.5" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p2.5.1" class="ltx_text">Finally, <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p2.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Delta\mathbf{b}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝐛</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Delta\mathbf{b}</annotation></semantics></math> is the centered vector of <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p2.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Delta\hat{\mathbf{y}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐲</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Delta\hat{\mathbf{y}}</annotation></semantics></math>. Centering a vector (projecting onto the subspace orthogonal to the constant vector <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_citep">(<a href="#bib.bib12" title="" class="ltx_ref">Arefidamghani et al., 2022</a>; <a href="#bib.bib11" title="" class="ltx_ref">Wang et al., 2010</a>)</cite>) is a non-expansive operation on <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p2.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\ell_{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">ℓ</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\ell_{2}</annotation></semantics></math> space, hence <math id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p2.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\|\Delta\mathbf{b}\|_{2}\leq\|\Delta\hat{\mathbf{y}}\|_{2}\leq\sqrt{S}\,\|\mathbf{w}\|_{2}\,\tilde{R}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝐛</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>≤</mo><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐲</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>≤</mo><mrow><msqrt><mi>S</mi></msqrt><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝐰</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>R</mi><mo>~</mo></mover></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\|\Delta\mathbf{b}\|_{2}\leq\|\Delta\hat{\mathbf{y}}\|_{2}\leq\sqrt{S}\,\|\mathbf{w}\|_{2}\,\tilde{R}</annotation></semantics></math>.
∎</span></p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px5" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">General Correlation Perturbation Lemma.</h5>

<div id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px5.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We utilize a general result bounding the change in the cosine similarity when one vector is perturbed.</p>
</div>
<div id="A4.Thmlemma2" class="ltx_theorem ltx_theorem_lemma">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_title_theorem"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_theorem"><span id="A4.Thmlemma2.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Lemma D.2</span></span><span id="A4.Thmlemma2.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold"> </span>(Correlation perturbation)<span id="A4.Thmlemma2.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">.</span></h6>
<div id="A4.Thmlemma2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A4.Thmlemma2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmlemma2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">For any <math id="A4.Thmlemma2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{a},\mathbf{b},\bm{\delta}\in\mathbb{R}^{S}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝐚</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>𝐛</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>𝛅</mi><mo>∈</mo><msup><mi>ℝ</mi><mi>S</mi></msup></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{a},\mathbf{b},\bm{\delta}\in\mathbb{R}^{S}</annotation></semantics></math> with <math id="A4.Thmlemma2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\|\bm{\delta}\|_{2}&lt;\|\mathbf{b}\|_{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝛅</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>&lt;</mo><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝐛</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\|\bm{\delta}\|_{2}&lt;\|\mathbf{b}\|_{2}</annotation></semantics></math>,</span></p>
<table id="A4.Ex15" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.Ex15.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Bigg|\frac{\mathbf{a}\cdot(\mathbf{b}+\bm{\delta})}{\|\mathbf{a}\|_{2}\,\|\mathbf{b}+\bm{\delta}\|_{2}}-\frac{\mathbf{a}\cdot\mathbf{b}}{\|\mathbf{a}\|_{2}\,\|\mathbf{b}\|_{2}}\Bigg|\;\leq\;\frac{2\,\|\bm{\delta}\|_{2}}{\|\mathbf{b}\|_{2}-\|\bm{\delta}\|_{2}}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo maxsize="2.600em" minsize="2.600em" stretchy="true">|</mo><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>𝐚</mi><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">⋅</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>𝐛</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>𝜹</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mrow><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝐚</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><mi>𝐛</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>𝜹</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow></mfrac><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>𝐚</mi><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">⋅</mo><mi>𝐛</mi></mrow><mrow><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝐚</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝐛</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow></mfrac></mrow><mo maxsize="2.600em" minsize="2.600em" rspace="0.280em" stretchy="true">|</mo></mrow><mo rspace="0.558em">≤</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0.170em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝜹</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow><mrow><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝐛</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝜹</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow></mfrac></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Bigg|\frac{\mathbf{a}\cdot(\mathbf{b}+\bm{\delta})}{\|\mathbf{a}\|_{2}\,\|\mathbf{b}+\bm{\delta}\|_{2}}-\frac{\mathbf{a}\cdot\mathbf{b}}{\|\mathbf{a}\|_{2}\,\|\mathbf{b}\|_{2}}\Bigg|\;\leq\;\frac{2\,\|\bm{\delta}\|_{2}}{\|\mathbf{b}\|_{2}-\|\bm{\delta}\|_{2}}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div id="A4.Thmlemma2.5" class="ltx_proof">
<h6 class="ltx_title ltx_runin ltx_font_italic ltx_title_proof">Proof.</h6>
<div id="A4.Thmlemma2.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A4.Thmlemma2.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.Thmlemma2.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text">Let <math id="A4.Thmlemma2.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\hat{\mathbf{a}}=\mathbf{a}/\|\mathbf{a}\|_{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐚</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>𝐚</mi><mo>/</mo><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>𝐚</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\hat{\mathbf{a}}=\mathbf{a}/\|\mathbf{a}\|_{2}</annotation></semantics></math>. Using triangle inequality, we have:</span></p>
<table id="A4.EGx49" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A4.E94"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A4.E94.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\left|\frac{\hat{\mathbf{a}}\cdot(\mathbf{b}+\bm{\delta})}{|\mathbf{b}+\bm{\delta}|_{2}}-\frac{\hat{\mathbf{a}}\cdot\mathbf{b}}{|\mathbf{b}|_{2}}\right|" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐚</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">⋅</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>𝐛</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>𝜹</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mrow><mi>𝐛</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>𝜹</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub></mfrac></mstyle><mo>−</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐚</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">⋅</mo><mi>𝐛</mi></mrow><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi>𝐛</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub></mfrac></mstyle></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\left|\frac{\hat{\mathbf{a}}\cdot(\mathbf{b}+\bm{\delta})}{|\mathbf{b}+\bm{\delta}|_{2}}-\frac{\hat{\mathbf{a}}\cdot\mathbf{b}}{|\mathbf{b}|_{2}}\right|</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A4.E94.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=\left|\frac{\hat{\mathbf{a}}\cdot\mathbf{b}}{|\mathbf{b}+\bm{\delta}|_{2}}-\frac{\hat{\mathbf{a}}\cdot\mathbf{b}}{|\mathbf{b}|_{2}}+\frac{\hat{\mathbf{a}}\cdot\bm{\delta}}{|\mathbf{b}+\bm{\delta}|_{2}}\right|" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐚</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">⋅</mo><mi>𝐛</mi></mrow><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mrow><mi>𝐛</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>𝜹</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub></mfrac></mstyle><mo>−</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐚</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">⋅</mo><mi>𝐛</mi></mrow><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi>𝐛</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub></mfrac></mstyle></mrow><mo>+</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐚</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">⋅</mo><mi>𝜹</mi></mrow><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mrow><mi>𝐛</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>𝜹</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub></mfrac></mstyle></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=\left|\frac{\hat{\mathbf{a}}\cdot\mathbf{b}}{|\mathbf{b}+\bm{\delta}|_{2}}-\frac{\hat{\mathbf{a}}\cdot\mathbf{b}}{|\mathbf{b}|_{2}}+\frac{\hat{\mathbf{a}}\cdot\bm{\delta}}{|\mathbf{b}+\bm{\delta}|_{2}}\right|</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(94)</span></td></tr></tbody>
<tbody id="A4.E95"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_eqn_cell"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A4.E95.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\leq\underbrace{\left|(\hat{\mathbf{a}}\cdot\mathbf{b})\left(\frac{1}{|\mathbf{b}+\bm{\delta}|_{2}}-\frac{1}{|\mathbf{b}|_{2}}\right)\right|}_{T_{1}}+\underbrace{\left|\frac{\hat{\mathbf{a}}\cdot\bm{\delta}}{|\mathbf{b}+\bm{\delta}|_{2}}\right|}_{T_{2}}." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>≤</mo><mrow><munder><munder accentunder="true"><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐚</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">⋅</mo><mi>𝐛</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mrow><mi>𝐛</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>𝜹</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub></mfrac></mstyle><mo>−</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi>𝐛</mi><mo
